title: 56.34 seconds, road unnamed
body: The margin keeps 56.34 seconds beside a barricade sketch, road unnamed. The key ring underneath carries a shed tag stamped with an acreage number, not an address.
rival_reading: The same acreage-stamped shed key and timed sketch could belong to a farm crew clearing its own service road; a bare margin note does not by itself show a failed evacuation.
gloss: A timed margin note with a barricade sketch travels with a shed key stamped by acreage, not address.

title: 1 minute, 14.55 seconds, acre-feet
body: The notebook keeps 1 minute, 14.55 seconds beside a water tally in acre-feet. A checkpoint stub is folded into the back page, stamped but not dated.
rival_reading: The same timed tally and stub could belong to an emergency crew logging water use while clearing a checkpoint; an acre-feet conversion alone does not fix it to a farm program.
gloss: A water tally in acre-feet keeps a timed entry beside a folded, undated checkpoint stub.

title: Acknowledgment, crew unclaimed
body: The dispatch copy is logged after a road closure, cause not given. It carries 56.34 seconds beside a spray-crew call sign, unclaimed since. A grocery list starts in the margin and stops mid-word.
rival_reading: The same spray-crew call sign and timed entry could belong to a farm operation working the same channel as an emergency unit; an unclaimed line does not prove an order went unheeded.
gloss: A dispatch copy follows a road closure and carries an unclaimed spray-crew call sign beside an abandoned grocery list.

title: Dispersal total, stub undated
body: The receipt keeps 1 minute, 14.55 seconds beside a dispersal total, signed. A checkpoint stub is paperclipped behind it, stamped but not dated. A phone number is scrawled sideways, no name attached.
rival_reading: The same stamped checkpoint stub and timed receipt could belong to any transfer slowed by a road closure; a dispersal total alone does not fix it to a farm shipment.
gloss: A signed dispersal total keeps an undated checkpoint stub and an unnamed scrawled phone number.
